structured_output.what_is_happening: SRUN "Runfolio" is a pump.fun coin that launched about 30 minutes before detection and migrated to PumpSwap, where it has 100% LP burn. In roughly its first hour it rose about 370%. It traded about $616k in volume against about $42k in liquidity (h1 turnover 14.6x), with around 2,500 unique buyers and 1,900 unique sellers. At detection it sat near $222k market cap, about 27% below its all-time high of about $304k, and was pulling back: -7% to -18% over the last 5 minutes. The pitch is an app-style product: run on Strava, earn points, get rewarded in tokenized NVIDIA, Tesla, Apple or S&P 500. It links a website and an X account called @RunfolioApp. The dev has already exited ("creator_close"), and the token is flagged as a community takeover. At least 9 copycat SRUN tokens have appeared, and one of them (FZqM…) has about $150k market cap and $165k in hourly volume.

narrative.description: A 'real app' story: a run-to-earn fitness app with rewards in tokenized stocks, plus a website and branded X account. This kind of utility-plus-tokenized-equities pitch can draw real attention in microcaps, especially if the app looks legitimate or a KOL posts about it.
narrative.why_spreading: About 2,500 unique buyers in an hour and several same-name copycats point to real attention on the name, likely driven by an X post or the app account. The last 5 minutes show slowing momentum and a pullback from the high, so the first wave may be peaking.

token_connection.why_this_token: Among the active SRUN tokens, this is the earliest mint (created at unix 1790306107). It is the one that migrated, it has the most volume and holders, and its DexScreener profile links runfolio.org and @RunfolioApp. One exception: a dead 'Runfolio' token was launched about 11 hours earlier.
token_connection.competing_tokens: FZqM… (non-pump mint, about $150k market cap, $27k liquidity, $165k hourly volume) is a real competitor that splits flow. 6wJr… traded $459k an hour but now shows $0 liquidity. The rest are dead clones.

authenticity.evidence: Broad participation: about 2,500 unique buyers, top-10 holders at 19% excluding pool and locker, and 27 smart wallets plus 4 renowned wallets. Against that: 263 bundler wallets, 17% held by the top bundler traders, a 61% bot/degen rate and 785 fresh wallets. The dev has exited and the coin is a community takeover. GMGN says the X account behind this dev launched 9 tokens, which suggests either a serial launcher or an app account that was tokenized by others several times. There is no paid DexScreener boost.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't tell whether @RunfolioApp is a real app team that endorses this token or just a name someone borrowed. I also can't see what triggered the attention.

structural_risks: The dev sold and the token is a community takeover, so no one is committed to supporting it
The copycat SRUN (FZqM) splits liquidity and attention
Bundlers hold about 17% of supply and could dump
The price is pulling back after a 370% hour-one run, and entry comes 25 minutes after detection, likely further into the fade
Hitting 2x means about $450k market cap, above the $304k all-time high

structured_output.counterargument: Real app narratives with a branded X account and a fitness/tokenized-stocks angle can re-rate hard. If the app team acknowledges the token or a big KOL posts about it, a coin with 2,500 buyers can easily reclaim its high and reach $450k–$1M. The LP is burned, so there can be no classic liquidity pull, and holders are fairly evenly spread.

structured_output.thesis: A coin with real participation and an app narrative that is already past its first 370% run. The dev has exited, a copycat is splitting the flow, the bundler share is high and momentum is fading. A double from entry would need a new high around $450k market cap, which requires a fresh catalyst. Most likely it drifts or bleeds to the stop; with the LP burned, a total rug is less likely than a slow death.
